title: Dynamic types, coercion, and equality — quick overview
rememberThis: Seven primitives copy on assign; objects alias by reference. `typeof null === 'object'` is a bug — use `=== null`.
Default to `===`. Use `==` only for `x == null` (null or undefined). Map/Set use SameValueZero.
`+` concatenates if either side is a string; otherwise ToNumber and add. Prefer explicit `Number()` at boundaries.
Eight falsy values: false, 0, -0, 0n, '', null, undefined, NaN. Use `??` for nullish defaults, not `||` when 0 is valid.
bullets: BigInt for integers past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (2⁵³ − 1). JSON.stringify throws on BigInt.
TypeScript types are erased at run time — validate `JSON.parse` results with schemas or guards.
Never `eval` JSON. Reject `__proto__` keys to prevent prototype pollution.
`structuredClone()` deep-clones in memory; JSON is for wire format only.
